what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in Azerbaijan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4893 Ukrainian refugees in Azerbaijan, 0.1% of all refugees from Ukraine.
Germany hosts the most Ukrainian refugees, followed by Poland, Czechia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in each of those years.
It also records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory in Ukraine from 2014 to 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2015 at 15 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 4906, at the end of 2024.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Azerbaijan.
These are year-end totals for Azerbaijan only, reported to UNHCR.
